key_points_correct: Correctly maps all four vulnerabilities to OWASP API Top 10 categories
WAF configuration includes rate limiting, query string blocking, managed rules, geo-blocking
Defense-in-depth covers API gateway, OAuth2 migration, CloudTrail auditing, field-level encryption
key_points_missing: BOLA fix uses IsOwnerOrReadOnly which allows unauthenticated reads bypassing ownership check -- does not use get_object as requested
WAF uses CLOUDFRONT scope instead of REGIONAL for ALB
Geo-block rule blocks the allowed countries instead of blocking all except those countries (logic inverted)
key_points_wrong: Geo-match statement blocks the listed countries rather than allowing only those countries
brief_justification: OWASP categorization and defense-in-depth design are good. However, the BOLA fix allows reads without ownership checks, the WAF scope is wrong for ALB, and the geo-blocking logic is inverted.
